items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: Was that the fella they called Red Mack later?

ctx.x: Yeah, there's, uh, Fessal Mack. He was a trumpet player. George Brown.
Was that the fella they called Red Mack later? Or Shorty Mack?
I don't know what Shorty Mack was. We called him Fess. Fess Mack.
